towns.name: Ayan Baqur
towns.summary: Ayan Baqur (60.0S 88.0W) is the isolated principal Gharu'ndim city on the far western shore of the Direlands, founded in Heroes' Respite: overrun by the Virindi, raided by Direlands monsters and the White Rabbit, camped by a Coral Golem Viceroy, and today a questing centre and the home of Ulgrim the Unpleasant (The Smoking Axe tavern). The town sits on a z 42 terrace between two hills: sandstone Gharu'ndim halls, a domed three-storey tavern, a glass-windowed church tower, tents, two wells and, in the open plaza, the town fountain ringed by a low fence and four glowing torches under two giant 39 m trees; the Town Network portal stands north of the fountain and the Colossus Foundry statue portal below the Nullified Statue of a Virindi. On the south hill (z 66) the Drudge Aviator's balloon with three blue-flame torches; on the north hill (z 72) the Life Stone, the casino VIP portals and the Carenzi Race Track with red flags; a forested slope runs 150 m down to the sea in the west.
